newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies tumble limit then bounce.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies tumble limit then bounce.

text.p: August and February CME pork bellies tumbled for limit losses of 3.000 cents per lb before bouncing back for net gains in very choppy trade, traders said.

Futures opened higher on carryover sell stops with prices up as much as 2.725 higher in August and 2.950 higher in Febraruy before falling all the way down for limit losses of 3.000 cents and then rallying, they said.
Futures are currently 0.075 cent a lb lower to 2.675 higher with July up 0.275 at 85.500 cents.
